name: Maryland

cover_rules: MD 340: Terminate cover crops between March 1 and June 1, 2027; mixes containing legumes should be terminated after May 1.
MD 340: Two-species mixes are 50% cereal grains and 50% brassicas or legumes; three-species mixes (50/25/25) need at least 50% eligible cereal grains.

seedWin.text: MD 340: Plant cereal grains by November 5, 2026.
MD 340: Plant oats or mixes containing legumes, forage radish, canola/rape by October 10, 2026.
